# routeros_system_package_update (Resource)

```terraform
resource "routeros_system_package_update" "settings" {
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `channel` (String) Possible values: `development`, `long-term`, `stable`, `testing`.
- `check_certificate` (String) Https certificate validation. Possible values: `no`, `yes`, `yes-without-crl`.
- `ip_version` (String) Possible values: `auto`, `ipv4`, `ipv6`.
- `mode` (String) Possible values: `http`, `https`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `installed_version` (String)
- `latest_version` (String)
- `status` (String)
